g.text: Architecture supports: VLA/Remote modes • 24/7 operation • Industrial robustness • Layered control
Key Features: Layered Domain Control • Mode Management • Trajectory Following • Direct UART Communication

svg.text: Centralized Domain Control with Distributed NXT Processing
Domain Control: Mode Management + Trajectory Following • Communication: uORB Bridge • VLA/Remote Dual Mode Operation

g.text: QE = Quadrature Encoder • AS5600 = Magnetic Encoder
DC = Domain Control Board • VLA = Vision-Language-Action (AI Controller) • uORB Bridge = Communication Hub

svg.text: Wheel Loader Robot System Architecture • PX4-Based Autonomous Control • Version 2.0 • September 2025
